Fidai taking equipment from another Fidai would become untapped at the
end of turn if successful?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:

<no...@nowhere.com> writes

>Fidai taking equipment from another Fidai would become untapped at the
>end of turn if successful?

Fida'i's untap limiting text only applies to the "normal" untap in untap
phase.

All other effects work as normal.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3B74B1E3...@videotron.ca>, GP41 <GP...@videotron.ca>
writes
>So i could equip

.... a Leather Jacket ....

>with Black Cat, then transfer with Anvil, and both
>would untap at the end of the my turn. Right?

Yes. Equip action covers both equipping with a card from your hand and
the movement of a card between two minions, so Leather Jacket's text
applies to any minion equipping it.
